scripts.desktop:build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter ./apps/desktop run build
scripts.desktop:start: pnpm run desktop:bundle-host && DRAWLOOM_WEB_ROOT=apps/desktop/build node apps/desktop/.dev/host/main.mjs
scripts.journal:render:article: remotion render publishing/site/remotion.tsx EpisodeSteps publishing/.generated/media/a-place-to-do-the-work/episode-steps.mp4 --codec=h264 --concurrency=2 && remotion still publishing/site/remotion.tsx EpisodeSteps publishing/.generated/media/a-place-to-do-the-work/episode-steps.png --frame=840
scripts.journal:preview: node scripts/build-journal.ts --drafts && cd publishing/site && astro preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4321
scripts.journal:check: cd publishing/site && astro check && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.journal:render: remotion render publishing/site/remotion.tsx Workbench publishing/.generated/media/workbench-example/workbench.mp4 --codec=h264 --concurrency=2 && remotion still publishing/site/remotion.tsx Workbench publishing/.generated/media/workbench-example/workbench.png --frame=450
scripts.spike:adr-0009:render: remotion render spikes/adr-0009-publishing/remotion.tsx Workbench spikes/adr-0009-publishing/public/media/workbench.mp4 --codec=h264 --concurrency=2 && remotion still spikes/adr-0009-publishing/remotion.tsx Workbench spikes/adr-0009-publishing/public/media/workbench.png --frame=450

scripts.check:design: designmd lint DESIGN.md && designmd lint publishing/DESIGN.md
scripts.test:temporal:compiled: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @drawloom/temporal-orchestration deploy --prod .deploy/temporal && DRAWLOOM_TEMPORAL_COMPILED=1 node --test packages/orchestration/temporal-orchestration/compiled-runtime.test.mjs
scripts.spike:adr-0017: bun run build:packages && node --experimental-strip-types --test spikes/adr-0017-orchestration/temporal-host.test.ts && bun build spikes/adr-0017-orchestration/temporal-worker.ts --target node --packages external --outdir spikes/adr-0017-orchestration/dist && node --experimental-strip-types spikes/adr-0017-orchestration/temporal-run.ts
scripts.desktop:bundle-host: esbuild apps/desktop/host/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:@napi-rs/keyring --banner:js='import { createRequire as __drawloomRequire } from "node:module"; const require = __drawloomRequire(import.meta.url);' --outfile=apps/desktop/.dev/host/main.mjs
